_meta.description: Hand-written, offline GPU vendor knowledge for heuristic triage of graphics errors. Written for this project; inspired by community compatibility knowledge (WineHQ AppDB, WinuxDB). No code or data is copied from external projects.
_meta.disclaimer: Entries are heuristic indicators for triage only, not root-cause proof.

intel.notes: Mesa iris/crocus drivers. For diagnosis only, LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 can help separate driver issues from application issues.

amd.notes: RADV (Mesa) or AMDGPU-pro. Verify vulkaninfo output before drawing conclusions.

nvidia.notes: Proprietary driver or NVK. Mixed driver setups are a common source of device-removed errors.

unknown.notes: Insufficient data; run the Vulkan probe to identify the vendor.
